the eddy current losses in the magnets of permanent magnet (PM) brushless machines having fractional numbers of slots per pole are influenced by the winding configuration, the magnet segmentation, the magnet width, and the operating mode.

the stator and rotor winding configurations, as well as operational mode, significantly affect the eddy current losses in the rotor magnets, and that the eddy current distribution in the rotor magnets can be significantly different from that in the rotor laminations.

the rotor magnet eddy current loss of permanent magnet brush less machines having a fractional slot/pole number is significantly dependent on the winding configuration of the stator, the operational mode, and the rotor geometry.
